title: Young Tree

stage.name: Young tree
stage.description: Branches spread out so more leaves can catch the light.

questions.prompt: Where does a tree grow taller?
options: At the tips of its shoots
At the base of the trunk
questions.why: Height growth happens at the tips. A nail in a trunk stays at the same height for decades.

questions.prompt: A slice of trunk shows 12 rings. About how old was the tree?
questions.why: A tree usually adds one ring a year: pale wood in spring and darker wood in late summer.

questions.prompt: Put a new branch's growth in order.
items: A bud forms at the tip
questions.why: Every new branch starts as a bud.

questions.prompt: Healthy couples keep their own friendships and interests as their relationship grows.
questions.why: Like branches, each person's own growth adds to the whole tree.

talk: What's one interest of yours you'd love the other to understand better?
